input: A signed specialist review confirms a single blackout of undetermined nature after completed investigations, no recurrent blackout and an event-free interval of 6 years; appropriate specialist information is available for the commercial assessment, whereas the driver's recollection of feeling light-headed during a recent blood draw is explicitly documented as preserved awareness rather than another blackout, so it is not added to the confirmed event count.

A signed specialist review confirms a single blackout of undetermined nature after completed investigations, no recurrent blackout and an event-free interval of 5.1 years; appropriate specialist information is available for the commercial assessment, whereas the driver's recollection of feeling light-headed during a recent blood draw is explicitly documented as preserved awareness rather than another blackout, so it is not added to the confirmed event count.

The current signed clinic summary documents persistent BP 176/96 mmHg after repeated seated measurements across separate visits, rather than the first reading taken while unloading; the driver describes pressure-like headaches after long shifts but has no current chest pain, while the dates of resumed treatment, sustained control and the specialist's initial assessment cannot be confirmed from the documents available today.

A current signed perimetry assessment confirms a visual field defect and reports a binocular horizontal extent of 138 degrees, although the driver can still read central letters clearly and points to an earlier normal acuity result; the report does not establish the required vertical test extent, stability of the field loss or whether other significant defects affect driving, and the specialist's detailed functional opinion remains pending.

The discharge summary confirms a severe hypoglycaemic event 5 weeks ago in a driver with insulin-treated diabetes, when confusion prevented self-treatment and another person had to give assistance, with contemporaneous glucose of 2.2 mmol/L; the nurse records the event and interval from the signed document, while a later glucose of 6.1 after treatment and the driver's improved appearance today do not erase the documented recent severe episode or supply a specialist return-to-driving assessment.

The specialist's signed history confirms two blackouts separated by more than 24 hours, with the last event 9.9 years ago and the mechanism still undetermined after completed investigations; the driver has had no more recent confirmed events, but the two episodes were not merely clustered in one day, and a family account that calls them one illness does not change the documented separation or the elapsed interval.

The discharge summary confirms a severe hypoglycaemic event 3 weeks ago in a driver with insulin-treated diabetes, when confusion prevented self-treatment and another person had to give assistance, with contemporaneous glucose of 2.2 mmol/L; the nurse records the event and interval from the signed document, while a later glucose of 6.1 after treatment and the driver's improved appearance today do not erase the documented recent severe episode or supply a specialist return-to-driving assessment.

The completed audiogram identifies unaided better-ear average hearing loss of 40 dB across 0.5, 1, 2 and 3 kHz, and the current clinical assessment records possible hearing loss; a hearing aid has been ordered rather than functionally assessed, the audiologist's advice about aided performance is not yet available, and the driver's belief that amplification will solve the difficulty is retained as an expectation rather than evidence that an aided standard has already been met.
